description:
As a customer, I want to sort the products.

* Sorting should work properly.

cases.title: Applying a sort option orders the product list by that option
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and shows <at least three products whose values differ for the sort option being tested>. At least one sort option is available on the product list.
steps: Note the products shown and their values for <the sort option to be tested>.
Select <a sort option available in the product list> from the sorting control.
Observe the order of the products in the list.
cases.expected: The products are displayed sorted by the selected sort option. The direction of the sort and any ordering of equal values are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Changing from one sort option to another re-sorts the list
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and shows <at least three products whose order differs between the two sort options being tested>. At least two sort options are available on the product list.
steps: Select <a first sort option available in the product list> and note the resulting product order.
Select <a second, different sort option available in the product list>.
Observe the order of the products in the list.
cases.expected: The list is re-sorted and the products are displayed sorted by the second selected sort option, not by the first one.

cases.title: Sorting a product list that contains a single product
cases.preconditions: The product list page is reachable and shows exactly one product (for example by using <a filter or category that matches only one product>). At least one sort option is available on the product list.
steps: Open the product list page so that exactly one product is shown.
Select <a sort option available in the product list> from the sorting control.
cases.expected: Sorting is applied without breaking the list: the single product is still displayed. No further behaviour for a single-product list is specified in the story.
